summary: Complete testing of Dashboard Layout Manager with react-grid-layout integration. All features working: KPI cards (Win Rate shows percentage 85.7%), edit mode with drag/resize, Template Manager CRUD, role assignment, year selector changing data. Backend: 11/11 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All interactions verified working.

issues: Console warnings about chart dimensions (-1 width/height) during initial load - charts render correctly after container calculates size. Not a blocking issue but could improve UX with skeleton/placeholder.

passed_tests: ✅ Dashboard loads correctly at /dashboard with data-testid='dashboard-page'
✅ Win Rate card displays formatted percentage (85.7%) not raw number
✅ Total Pipeline shows OMR 2,463,001.75 with currency formatting
✅ Open Opportunities shows count (17)
✅ Won This Period shows OMR 417,047.19
✅ Edit Layout button toggles edit mode (shows amber banner with instructions)
✅ Add Card button visible in edit mode
✅ Save Layout button appears when changes are made (data-testid='save-layout-btn')
✅ Templates button opens Template Manager dialog
✅ Template Manager shows list of templates with role assignments
✅ Template Manager allows creating new templates
✅ Template Manager allows editing template name, description, and role assignments
✅ Template Manager allows deleting templates
✅ Pipeline by Stage chart renders correctly
✅ Sales Leaderboard renders with salesperson rankings
✅ Year selector changes dashboard data (2025 shows different values: Win Rate 68.0%, Pipeline OMR 8.7M, 142 open opps)
✅ Backend API: GET /api/card-builder/my-dashboard returns template and 11 blocks
✅ Backend API: GET /api/card-builder/templates returns 1 template (CEO Dashboard)
✅ Backend API: POST /api/card-builder/templates creates new template
✅ Backend API: PUT /api/card-builder/templates/{id} updates template
✅ Backend API: DELETE /api/card-builder/templates/{id} deletes template
✅ Backend API: GET /api/card-builder/available-roles returns roles list
✅ Backend API: POST /api/card-builder/templates/{id}/layout saves layout
critical_code_review_comments: Win Rate calculation correctly uses Won/(Won+Lost) formula with groups data from backend
react-grid-layout v2.2.2 integration using ResponsiveGridLayout, useContainerWidth hook, and verticalCompactor working correctly
Template blocks structure uses {i, x, y, w, h, type: 'query_card', card_id} format
12-column grid layout with proper positioning and sizing
